scope: Development hypothesis from posthoc N0; no independent confirmation
preprocessing: Raw causal H11 in frozen order -> N0 mean fill/scaling -> frozen PH. Outer scaler on farm fit rows only. Zero-shot and FT use Kelmarsh outer scaler, no target statistics. Power last, labels unchanged.
support: MAE gain CI95 low >0 AND family Holm p<=0.05 AND RMSE gain CI95 low>0
decision: continue if ZP supported and IP noninferior; partial if ZP unsupported and (F1P or F3P supported); otherwise stop
execution: Verify historical reference arrays/checkpoints and input hashes; freeze all 36 selected fits before one evaluation; no resume, no baseline refit, no PH retraining, no label edits, no additional arms or years
